requirement: Load application settings from prefixed environment variables into a typed, validated object without leaking secret values in errors.
skeleton: A ConfigError, a frozen Settings dataclass and a load function with integer and boolean helpers that validate ranges and spellings.
caption: A settings loader over os.environ using collections.abc Mapping and a frozen dataclass. load reads prefixed variables from the given mapping, or os.environ only when none is passed, treats blank values as unset and raises ConfigError, a ValueError subclass, when the database URL is missing, an integer is malformed or outside its inclusive range, or a boolean is not one of the case-insensitive true or false words. Integer errors are raised from None so the raw value never appears in the message or the exception context. The fixture asserts defaults, parsing, prefixes, the empty mapping, range errors and no leaked values.

plan.intent: Configure a web service from env vars
constraints: A missing database URL raises ConfigError
Blank variables fall back to defaults
An explicitly empty mapping is used instead of os.environ

rationale.teaches: Resolve the mapping with an explicit None check, normalize before parsing, and raise from None so parse errors do not carry the value.
rationale.why: Config loaders leak secrets through chained exceptions and quietly fall back to the process environment when handed an empty mapping.

ops.docstring: Load typed settings from prefixed environment variables.

ops.source:
class ConfigError(ValueError):
    """Raised for a missing or malformed setting, without echoing its value."""

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Settings:
    """Validated application settings."""

    database_url: str
    port: int = 8000
    debug: bool = False
    workers: int = 1

candidates.why_wrong: An empty mapping falls back to os.environ and picks up unrelated settings.
Upper-case boolean words such as YES are rejected.
The inclusive limits such as port 65535 are rejected.
The int parse error stays chained, so the raw secret appears in tracebacks.
A missing database URL builds Settings with None instead of raising.
